verdict.rationale: Outlook's docs say users can 'flag a message for follow-up,' which partly covers the follow-up part of this story. Nothing documents snoozing, reminder timing, or a thread resurfacing automatically when nobody replies. missing for 10: snooze conversations, timed follow-up reminders, automatic resurfacing when there is no reply, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: app users can change the importance of a message (or event or task), or flag a message for follow-up.
